subject: [PATCH v4 00/13] mm/collapse: separate a collapse from its callers

2026-10-01.patch_summary: This patch series separates a collapse operation from its callers, improving code organization and reducing redundancy. The first patch in the series removes an unnecessary mmgrab() reference in madvise_collapse(). The remaining patches are not described in this summary.
